rationale: STATEFULNESS (Tier-1): uses-dedup and virtual registries were stored on the analyzer INSTANCE, leaking across files under parallel indexing - an identical second file lost its Uses edges entirely. State is now per-analyze. Re-authored (M37.9): the original pinned `uses timeout` from `config.timeout = 5;` — a member WRITE that CPPD2 now correctly gates (family write-is-not-a-use contract, fmt probe xchar/chrono-test). The write in setup() must emit NO uses; the genuine READ in read() emits uses timeout (distinct sources, so the dedup key cannot mask a write leak).
